register_mcss_roles: register the filesize and filesize-gz reStructuredText roles with mcss settings for documentation builds
use_filesize_role: use the filesize reStructuredText role to display a file's size in human-readable units in docs
use_filesize_gz_role: use the filesize-gz reStructuredText role to display a gzip-compressed file size in human-readable units
configure_pelican_plugin: configure the Pelican plugin by connecting the initialized signal to set up filesize roles
summarize_filesize_module: summarize the filesize module that provides reStructuredText roles for displaying file sizes in documentation
